    while True:

        parent = os.path.dirname(curr)
        if parent == curr:

        curr = parent
    return None

def get_notebook_dir(args):

    root = find_notebook_root(getattr(args, 'working_dir', None) or os.getcwd())
    if not root:

    return root

    if not os.path.exists(db_path):
        try:

    notes = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(notebook_root):
        if ".zk" in dirs:
            dirs.remove(".zk")
        for file in files:
            if file.endswith(".md"):
                path = os.path.join(root, file)
                rel_path = os.path.relpath(path, notebook_root)
                with open(path, "r") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                title = ""
                for line in content.splitlines():
                    if line.startswith("# "):
                        title = line[2:].strip()
                        break
                notes.append({"path": rel_path, "title": title})
    
    notes.sort(key=lambda x: x["path"])
    
    if args.format == "json":

    elif args.format == "jsonl":
        for n in notes:
            print(json.dumps(n))

def find_notebook_root(start_path):
    curr = os.path.abspath(start_path)
    while True:
        if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(curr, ".zk")):
            return curr
        parent = os.path.dirname(curr)
        if parent == curr:
            break
        curr = parent
    return None

def get_notebook_dir(args):
    if hasattr(args, 'notebook_dir') and args.notebook_dir:
        return os.path.abspath(args.notebook_dir)
    root = find_notebook_root(getattr(args, 'working_dir', None) or os.getcwd())
    if not root:
        print("zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {} or a parent directory".format(os.getcwd()), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    return root

def cmd_init(args):
    notebook_dir = args.directory or os.getcwd()
    if not args.no_input:
        try:
            sys.stdout.write("\033[0G\033[2K\033[0;1;92m? \033[0m\033[0;1;99mDo you prefer [[WikiLinks]] over regular Markdown links? \033[0m\033[0;37m(y/N) \033[0m")
            sys.stdout.flush()
            input()
        except EOFError:
            print("\nzk: error: EOF", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

    zk_dir = os.path.join(notebook_dir, ".zk")
    if not os.path.exists(zk_dir):
        os.makedirs(zk_dir)
    templates_dir = os.path.join(zk_dir, "templates")
    if not os.path.exists(templates_dir):
        os.makedirs(templates_dir)
    config_path = os.path.join(zk_dir, "config.toml")
    if not os.path.exists(config_path):
        with open(config_path, "w") as f:
            f.write(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    template_path = os.path.join(templates_dir, "default.md")
    if not os.path.exists(template_path):
        with open(template_path, "w") as f:
            f.write("# {{title}}\n\n{{content}}\n")
    
    db_path = os.path.join(zk_dir, "notebook.db")
    if not os.path.exists(db_path):
        try:
            conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
            conn.execute("CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE notes_fts USING fts5(title, content);")
            conn.execute("CREATE TABLE notes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, path TEXT, title TEXT, content TEXT, created_at TEXT, modified_at TEXT);")
            conn.execute("CREATE TABLE tags (note_id TEXT, tag TEXT);")
            conn.execute("CREATE TABLE links (source_id TEXT, target_id TEXT);")
            conn.commit()
            conn.close()
        except sqlite3.OperationalError as e:
            if "no such module: fts5" in str(e):
                print("zk: error: failed to open notebook: failed to migrate the database: database migration failed: no such module: fts5", file=sys.stderr)
                sys.exit(1)
            raise

def cmd_new(args):
    notebook_root = get_notebook_dir(args)
    target_dir = os.path.join(notebook_root, args.directory) if args.directory else notebook_root
    if not os.path.exists(target_dir):
        os.makedirs(target_dir)
    
    note_id = args.id or "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits, k=4))
    filename = f"{note_id}.md"
    filepath = os.path.join(target_dir, filename)
    rel_path = os.path.relpath(filepath, notebook_root)
    
    title = args.title or "Untitled"
    content = ""
    if args.interactive:
        content = sys.stdin.read()
    
    template_content = "# {{title}}\n\n{{content}}\n"
    template_path = os.path.join(notebook_root, ".zk", "templates", args.template or "default.md")
    if os.path.exists(template_path):
        with open(template_path, "r") as f:
            template_content = f.read()
    
    rendered = template_content.replace("{{title}}", title).replace("{{content}}", content)
    
    if args.dry_run:
        print(rendered, end="")
        sys.stderr.write(rel_path + "\n")
    else:
        with open(filepath, "w") as f:
            f.write(rendered)
        if args.print_path:
            print(rel_path)
        else:
            editor = os.environ.get("EDITOR") or os.environ.get("VISUAL") or "vi"
            subprocess.call([editor, filepath])

def cmd_list(args):
    notebook_root = get_notebook_dir(args)
    notes = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(notebook_root):
        if ".zk" in dirs:
            dirs.remove(".zk")
        for file in files:
            if file.endswith(".md"):
                path = os.path.join(root, file)
                rel_path = os.path.relpath(path, notebook_root)
                with open(path, "r") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                title = ""
                for line in content.splitlines():
                    if line.startswith("# "):
                        title = line[2:].strip()
                        break
                notes.append({"path": rel_path, "title": title})
    
    notes.sort(key=lambda x: x["path"])
    
    if args.format == "json":
        print(json.dumps(notes))
    elif args.format == "jsonl":
        for n in notes:
            print(json.dumps(n))
    else:
        for n in notes:
            print(f"{n['path']}: {n['title']}")
    
    if not args.quiet:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{len(notes)} notes found\n")

        args = p.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])
        cmd_new(args)
    elif command == "list":
        p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='zk list')
        p.add_argument("paths", nargs="*")
        p.add_argument("-f", "--format", default="medium")

        p.add_argument("--notebook-dir", metavar="PATH")
